summary.text: Joe Ludwig is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 29, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Alex Pereszlenyi.
The Republican primary was canceled and Ludwig advanced without appearing on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ludwig ran in the 2012 election for California State Assembly District 61 and was eliminated in the June 5, 2012 blanket primary, receiving 15.9 percent of the vote.
In 2022 he sought the Republican nomination for Clark County Commission District G in Nevada and lost the June 14, 2022 primary to Norman Mitchell, 46.1 percent to 53.9 percent.
